# LMM

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(rprojroot)

proj_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file_pattern("\\.Rproj$"))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = proj_root)
```

## Input functions

```{r}
source("analysis/05_LMM/fun_lmm_split.R")
source("analysis/05_LMM/fun_plot_lmm_split.R")

dir.create("results/05_LMM", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("figures/05_LMM/LMM", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

behavior_csv <- "data/05_LMM/behavior_single_trial.csv"
```

## Colors

```{r}
# Action: blue vs orange
col_action_voluntary   <- "#2A95E8"
col_action_involuntary <- "#FFAA3D"

# Outcome: green vs pink
col_outcome_voluntary   <- "#83D768"
col_outcome_involuntary <- "#F98EAE"
```

# Action binding

## Model results

```{r}
roi_files_action <- list(
  PreSMAR = "data/05_LMM/feature/PreSMAR_action_ba.csv",
  SMAR    = "data/05_LMM/feature/SMAR_action_ba.csv"
)

res_list_action <- lapply(names(roi_files_action), function(roi) {
  run_lmm_split(
    feature_csv = roi_files_action[[roi]],
    behavior_csv = behavior_csv,
    scale_features = TRUE,
    condition_levels = c("va_a", "ia_a"),
    exclude_subjects = c(19)
  )
})

names(res_list_action) <- names(roi_files_action)

wide_all_action <- bind_rows(lapply(names(res_list_action), function(roi) {
  res_list_action[[roi]]$fixed_table_wide %>%
    mutate(ROI = roi, .before = 1)
}))

wide_all_action
```

## Save model results

```{r}
write_csv(
  wide_all_action,
  file.path("results/05_LMM", "action_binding.csv")
)

cat("Saved:\n", file.path("results/05_LMM", "action_binding.csv"), "\n")
```

## Plot ITPC coefficients

```{r}
Fig_p_value_action <- plot_group_itpc(
  res_list = res_list_action,
  roi_order = c("SMAR", "PreSMAR"),
  conditions = c("va_a", "ia_a"),
  cond_labels = c(
    va_a = "Voluntary",
    ia_a = "Involuntary"
  ),
  cond_colors = c(
    va_a = col_action_voluntary,
    ia_a = col_action_involuntary
  ),
  group_title = "Action binding: ITPC coefficients"
)

Fig_p_value_action
```

## Save plot

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "figures/05_LMM/LMM/action_binding_p_value.pdf",
  plot = Fig_p_value_action,
  width = 7,
  height = 10.5,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  family = "Arial"
)

cat("Saved:\n", "figures/05_LMM/LMM/action_binding_p_value.pdf", "\n")
```

# Outcome binding

## Model results

```{r}
roi_files_outcome <- list(
  PostcentralL = "data/05_LMM/feature/PostcentralL_outcome_bs.csv",
  MTGR         = "data/05_LMM/feature/MTGR_outcome_bs.csv"
)

res_list_outcome <- lapply(names(roi_files_outcome), function(roi) {
  run_lmm_split(
    feature_csv = roi_files_outcome[[roi]],
    behavior_csv = behavior_csv,
    scale_features = TRUE,
    condition_levels = c("vs_s", "is_s"),
    exclude_subjects = NULL
  )
})

names(res_list_outcome) <- names(roi_files_outcome)

wide_all_outcome <- bind_rows(lapply(names(res_list_outcome), function(roi) {
  res_list_outcome[[roi]]$fixed_table_wide %>%
    mutate(ROI = roi, .before = 1)
}))

wide_all_outcome
```

## Save model results

```{r}

cat("Saved:\n", file.path("results/05_LMM", "outcome_binding.csv"), "\n")
```

## Plot ITPC coefficients

```{r}

cat("Saved:\n", "figures/05_LMM/LMM/outcome_binding_p_value.pdf", "\n")
```
